title: AMRIT country profile
description: The single source of country-varying behaviour for both the desktop application and the web server. A profile is either curated (checked in beside this schema) or synthesized at runtime from shared/country-profiles/reference/countries.json.

profile_id.description: Stable identifier. Curated profiles use the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; synthesized profiles use the alpha-3.

source.description: How this profile was produced. Set by the registry, not by hand.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3. This is what exporters emit.

who_region.description: AFRO, AMRO/PAHO, EMRO, EURO, SEARO, WPRO, or Other.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag used for formatting and translation lookup.

numbering_system.description: CLDR numbering system, e.g. latn, arab, arabext, deva. Drives display AND input normalisation.

timezone.description: Canonical IANA identifier, the deployment default only. Null when the country spans several zones and an explicit choice is required. Individual sites may always override.

timezone_ambiguous.description: True when the country spans more than one IANA zone, so a country-level default would mis-stamp dates at day boundaries.

calendar.description: Civil calendar for DISPLAY only. Storage is always ISO-8601 Gregorian UTC.

date_input_order.description: How to disambiguate a typed date such as 03/04/2026.

epi_week_system.description: Epidemiological week definition. ISO-8601 weeks and US MMWR weeks can differ by a week and will otherwise mis-bucket surveillance counts.

fiscal_year_start_month.description: Reporting-year start. India 4, United States 10, most countries 1.

admin_levels.description: Sub-national hierarchy, outermost first. An empty array is valid for a city-state with no subdivisions.

code_system.description: Authority for the codes at this level, e.g. ISO3166-2, LGD, GeoNames, FIPS, or a national scheme.

identifier_namespace.description: Written into every FHIR resource this deployment emits. Changing it after export splits identifier continuity for downstream consumers.

effective_from.description: When this namespace took effect. Recorded because bundles exported before it carry the previous system URIs, so past exports stay explainable.

app_id.description: OS bundle identifier. Build-time only — it cannot be changed at runtime.

logo.description: Filename of a bundled mark, or an uploaded data URI. A bundled name must exist under both products' asset roots — app/src/renderer/public/resources/ and central/static/img/ — because the profile does not know which product is reading it. tools/generate_brand_assets.py writes both.

logo_reverse.description: The same mark reversed for dark backgrounds, such as the desktop application's navy sidebar. Optional: where it is absent the interface falls back to placing the light-background mark on a plate, which is legible but heavier.

code_systems.description: Per-vocabulary gating. Some vocabularies are licence-restricted and must not ship enabled everywhere.

banned_identifier_keys.description: National identifier field names that must never appear in an ingested payload or an LLM prompt.

patient_postal_code_digits.description: Leading characters of a patient's postal code kept in anything that leaves the deployment; 0 drops it entirely. Null means the built-in default (3). What counts as identifying depends on population density and local law, so this is the deployment's call.

tile_url.description: Basemap tiles. Null means use the built-in offline fallback — several deployments cannot reach a public tile CDN.
